array.string: import os, shutil, pathlib; candidates=[]; venv=os.environ.get('VIRTUAL_ENV'); candidates.append(os.path.join(venv,'bin','python3')) if venv else None; which=shutil.which('python3'); candidates.append(which) if which else None; candidates.extend(['/usr/local/bin/python3','/usr/bin/python3']); python_path=next((p for p in candidates if p and pathlib.Path(p).is_file() and os.access(p, os.X_OK)), '/usr/bin/python3'); target=os.path.expanduser('~/.jarvis/chat_interface.py'); os.execv(python_path, [python_path, target])
